the amount paid to Spotify for March
the computed shortfall amount and the payee name Spotify

nodes.name: ReadPriceNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price-increase notice the user received and extract the new price and the percentage increase

nodes.name: ReadMarchTransaction
nodes.role: find the March payment to Spotify in the transaction history and extract the amount paid

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out the difference between the new price and the amount actually paid for March

nodes.name: ConfirmShortfall
nodes.role: show the user the computed shortfall and the payee, and obtain their approval before any payment

nodes.name: SendShortfallPayment
nodes.role: send the approved shortfall amount to Spotify

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the shortfall payment was sent and its confirmation details
